name: trip-copilot-prompt-evaluation
description: Deterministic plugin-local prompt evaluation set for the plan-business-trip skill and the trip-copilot MCP tool contract. No external AI services are called; every case is checked against the skill text, the backend MCP adapter source, and the tool catalog contract. Each check is a concrete expected fact that fails meaningfully when absent.

cases.summary: Missing departure date/time/location and transport must trigger clarifying questions before any mutation.
checks: skill-text: Ask one missing question at a time
skill-text: departure location, destination, departure date/time

cases.summary: Private car must be supported as transport with its own question flow.
No non-read-only tool call may happen before explicit affirmative user confirmation.
checks: skill-text: Before every non-read-only MCP tool call, show the user a concise proposed itinerary/reminder change
skill-text: obtain their explicit affirmative confirmation
skill-text: Do not call the tool if the user declines, equivocates, or asks to stop

cases.summary: A logical write must reuse the same non-secret idempotency key on retry.
checks: skill-text: Generate one non-secret key per logical write
skill-text: reuse the same key with the same payload when retrying a write

cases.summary: When consent is declined the workflow must stop safely without mutating.
checks: skill-text: stop safely, summarize what was and was not changed, and offer next steps
skill-text: Do not call the tool if the user declines
skill-text: Not ask again if the user already confirmed this exact change

cases.summary: Provider partial failures and provenance in tool results must be surfaced to the user.
checks: skill-text: If a tool result contains provider failures or provenance fields
skill-text: report them to the user explicitly with what succeeded and what did not
skill-text: Distinguish recommendations produced by the server from anything you assume yourself

cases.summary: Recommendations are only requested after the user accepts follow-up consent.
checks: skill-text: Never claim bookings or payments

cases.summary: The skill must never trust or request an owner identity; the deployment-fixed Demo Owner applies.
checks: skill-text: Never ask the user for an owner identity, user id, or email
skill-text: never send an identity header or argument

cases.summary: All sixteen tools are exposed with a nonblank top-level description and the closed-schema/idempotency/structuredContent contract.
Annotation classification is truthful: read-only tools are idempotent repeat-safe reads, writes carry idempotency hints, destructive tools are not read-only, and open-world tools are marked.
